concept: DMS: continuous replication (CDC) during DB migration
tests: Choosing a service to migrate on-premises Oracle to Aurora with continuous replication and minimal downtime.
expected: AWS DMS with ongoing replication (CDC) + SCT for heterogeneous schema conversion. Triggers: "continuously replicate", "on-premises Oracle to Aurora", "minimal downtime".
why_not: DataSync — files/objects; Snowball — offline bulk; Transfer Acceleration — faster uploads to S3.
